hypotheses.statement: A sed-shaped single-byte mutation (schema_version → schemX_version) matched the signature of the mutation suite, and commit c38ee4ff records that interrupting the mutation suite previously corrupted the tree it exists to protect. Hypothesis: a concurrent or earlier mutation-suite run wrote through a hardlinked LFS object path (worktrees share .git/lfs/objects) and left the object-store body mutated while the working tree retained the original payload.
supporting_observations: object store is hardlinked / shared across worktrees
worktree copies were intact and matched pointer oids
c38ee4ff documents mutation-suite tree corruption on interrupt
not_established: no disposable reproduction has shown mutation-test.sh writing into .git/lfs/objects
no process audit tied a specific mutation run to these two oids
arrival-batching.json corruption shape was content-different-at-same-size without the schemX marker, so a single mechanism is not proven for both

hypotheses.statement: git lfs fsck skips paths matching lfs.fetchexclude. With fetchexclude=evidence/perf/**, default fsck does not check the tier-2 evidence objects — so OK is not evidence of their integrity.
hypotheses.note: Explains the false green; does not identify who wrote the bad bytes.

root_cause.policy: Do not claim root cause without a disposable reproduction. 'Did not reproduce in N attempts' is a valid result.

to_promote_hypothesis_to_cause: Throwaway clone with its own lfs.storage (never the shared merc store)
Hydrated evidence/perf payload that is also LFS-tracked
Run scripts/mutation-test.sh (or the specific mutator suspected) against a control file while an LFS-tracked evidence path is open/hardlinked
Show that after the run, sha256(object-store bytes) != oid for a named oid while git lfs fsck still exits 0
Capture: mutator command, before/after object hashes, fsck output, hardlink count (stat -f %l)

attempts_in_this_programme.verdict: Coupling mechanism confirmed in disposable clone (hardlinked worktree write yields the exact incident corrupt digest). Agent that created the original hardlink or wrote the bytes remains UNPROVEN. mutation-test.sh alone does not create the hardlink.

consequences_if_unrepaired: A subsequent git lfs push would have published the corrupt bodies as the canonical remote objects; intact worktree copies would eventually be smudged away.
remediation_landed: object store restored from intact worktree payloads for both oids
independent corpus verifier (scripts/verify-lfs-corpus.py + TestLFSCorpusIntegrity) becomes the authority
git lfs fsck retained only as supplementary cross-check
